prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling school science fair. On the far left, a boy in a blue cap leans forward eagerly, his eyes fixed on a bubbling green liquid inside a clear glass beaker that sits atop a wooden table. Next to the beaker, a girl with pigtails points a slender finger at the rising foam, her mouth open in surprise. Behind them stands a teacher in a tweed jacket, observing the experiment with a calm demeanor while holding a clipboard. In the center of the room, a tall volcano model made of papier-mâché dominates the space, its crater stained with dried red paint. A small robot with blinking lights sits next to the volcano, its metal arms raised in a static pose. To the right of the robot, a cat with orange fur sleeps peacefully on a folded blanket, ignoring the chaos around it. Near the cat, a man in a red scarf looks down at a poster board displaying complex diagrams, his hands clasped behind his back. Beside him, a woman in a yellow dress gestures toward the diagrams, explaining the concepts to a teenager in a hoodie who listens intently. In the background, a stack of textbooks rests on a shelf, slightly askew. A potted fern hangs from the ceiling above the central display, its leaves drooping slightly. A janitor in gray overalls sweeps the floor near the entrance, pushing a broom with steady strokes. A lost sneaker lies under a chair near the sweeper, abandoned in the rush. A balloon tied to a string floats near the ceiling, drifting slowly to the left. There is no digital screen visible in the display area. There is no fire extinguisher mounted on the walls.
